evidence_chunks.text: Built a full-stack web application to track personal expenses with category-based analytics and monthly budget alerts.
Tech stack: React frontend, Express.js REST API, PostgreSQL database. Deployed on Railway.
Users can create accounts, add expenses with custom categories, view spending trends via Chart.js visualizations, and set monthly budgets per category.
The app uses PostgreSQL with a nightly backup job and stores user expenses in a normalized schema with categories, merchants, and recurring transactions.
